summary.result: In the future, studies on other factors affecting N₂O emissions are needed.
summary.background: Nitrogen dioxide (N₂O) accounts for the third largest share of global greenhouse gas emissions after carbon dioxide (CO₂) and methane (CH4).
summary.method: N₂O emissions from the soil are affected by temperature, pH, rainfall, fertilizer use, and cultivation method, among other factors.
